title: All branches and Today show different numbers for the same branch under the same words
what: On All branches, each branch's 'Fees due' leaves out plans that have not started yet, while that branch's Today tile 'Fees due' counts them. 'Plans ending in 7 days' counts today plus 6 days, while Today's ending tiles run to 7 days ahead. 'Came in today' on All branches counts everyone who trained AT that branch, while Today's 'Came in today' counts that branch's own members wherever they trained. An owner who compares a branch row with its Today screen sees two different amounts and counts.
expected: One rule per number: the All branches row for a branch shows the same Fees due, ending soon and came-in count as that branch's Today screen, or the words say how they differ.
who: owners with more than one branch
how_often: every day a plan is sold in advance, ends on day 7, or a member trains at another branch
fix_line: Make All branches use the same counting rules as the Today screen

title: A person who paid when joining online and is then marked lost is reported as a member who may have paid twice
what: Self-join pay online is live. If the desk marks a paid online joiner as lost on Enquiries instead of pressing Approve, the gym holds their money but they are not a member. The 'Paid online, receipt not made' card then says they 'were made a member without Approve' and 'may have paid twice', and tells the desk to save the payment on their member page. There is no member page and no Open member button, and nothing says the money should be refunded.
expected: A paid joiner cannot be closed without a choice (Approve, or refund), or the card says plainly: this person paid but did not join, refund them.
who: desk staff and owners using self-join pay online
how_often: each time a paid joiner is marked lost
fix_line: Give a paid joiner who did not join its own message that says to refund them

title: On a basic door machine, a member whose plan ended keeps getting in until someone opens the admin app
what: Basic fingerprint machines (the kind that cannot hold an end date) only stop a lapsed member when the admin app sends a 'remove' order. That order is worked out only inside an open admin app, once a day, by the first desk that opens it. If nobody opens the admin app on a holiday or a weekend, the door keeps letting in members whose plan ended, for free, until someone does.
expected: A plan that ends shuts the door the next morning whether or not anyone opens the admin app, worked out on the server.
who: gyms with a basic door machine
how_often: every day nobody opens the admin app
fix_line: Run the nightly door update on the server instead of inside the admin app

title: A desk that chose Hinglish switches back to English when it moves to the new address
what: When the admin app sends a desk from the old address to the new one, it carries over the gym, the branch keys and the light or dark choice. The language choice (Hinglish) is not carried over, so the desk suddenly reads English and must find the language setting again.
expected: Every choice the desk made on the old address, the language included, is there at the new address.
how_often: once per device, on the move
fix_line: Carry the language choice over with the other saved choices
